shows.title: Low Tide Hours
shows.blurb: A slow walk along the shore at low water, and what the tide leaves behind.
shows.about: Ada and grace walk a different stretch of shore at every low tide: rock pools, sand bars, wrecks and harbors that empty twice a day. No hurry, and always back before the water.

shows.title: The Harbor Log
shows.blurb: Boats in, boats out: the week at the harbor, told by the people who work it.
shows.about: A week at the harbor in a few minutes: who came in, what they brought, what broke and who fixed it. Grace keeps the log, linus asks the questions.

shows.title: Field Notes from Larkspur
shows.blurb: Walks across the larkspur hills, a notebook in one hand.
shows.about: Margaret walks the hills above larkspur in every season and reads from her notebook on the way: birds, plants, weather and the paths between the villages.

shows.title: Juniper Weather
shows.blurb: The week ahead, explained slowly, from the station on juniper ridge.
shows.about: Linus reads the instruments at the juniper ridge station and explains the week's weather without a single chart: where the wind comes from, why the fog sits in the valley, and when to bring a coat.

shows.title: Tidevann Weekly
shows.blurb: What changed in Tidevann this week: jobs, runs and the people who keep them going.
shows.about: Ada and linus go through the week in Tidevann: which jobs ran, which failed and why, what changed in the harbor, juniper and larkspur projects, and what is coming next.

shows.title: Islands, One by One
shows.blurb: One island an episode: how it was made, who lives there, and how to get there.
shows.about: Every episode is one island: how it was made, how many people live there and what they do, and the ferry, the bridge or the boat it takes to get there.

shows.title: Rivers and Deltas
shows.blurb: Following the water from the mountains down to the sea.
shows.about: Linus and margaret follow one river an episode, from the snow where it starts to the delta where it ends: the valleys it cut, the towns on its banks and the floods they remember.

shows.title: Lighthouse Stories
shows.blurb: The keepers, the lamps and the long nights on the coast.
shows.about: Grace visits a lighthouse an episode and tells its story: who built it, who kept it, the storms it saw and what it does now that nobody lives there.

shows.title: Salt and Stone
shows.blurb: Coastal rock, sand and the slow work of the sea on the land.
shows.about: Ada looks closely at the coast itself: the cliffs, the beaches, the dunes and the slow work the sea does on all of them, a grain of sand at a time.

shows.title: The Night Shift
shows.blurb: What runs while everyone sleeps: the nightly jobs and the people on call.
shows.about: The jobs that run at night and the people who answer when they fail: nightly-export, rebuild-index, the scheduler and the worker, told from the on-call rota.

episodes.title: Sand bars of the long bay
episodes.summary: The long bay drains further than anywhere on the coast. We walk out to the farthest sand bar and back before the flood.

episodes.title: A wreck at the river mouth
episodes.summary: Twice a year the lowest tides uncover an old wreck at the river mouth. Grace has waited three years to see it.

episodes.title: The causeway to the island
episodes.summary: For two hours at low water you can walk to the island. Ada times it, grace brings the tide table.

episodes.title: Mussels on the breakwater
episodes.summary: The breakwater is covered in mussels at low water. We count them, badly, and ask why they grow there.

episodes.title: A new crane on the quay
episodes.summary: The old crane came down this week and the new one went up. Linus asks who gets to drive it.

episodes.title: The ferry that came in late
episodes.summary: The morning ferry came in three hours late. Grace finds out why, and who waited.

episodes.title: Nets, ropes and the chandlery
episodes.summary: Inside the chandlery, where the boats get everything from rope to coffee.

episodes.title: Winter berths
episodes.summary: Which boats stay in for the winter, which leave, and how they all fit.

episodes.title: The first frost on the hills
episodes.summary: The first frost of the year, the last of the late flowers, and a very cold notebook.

episodes.title: The path between two villages
episodes.summary: An old path between two villages on the ridge, walked end to end in an afternoon.

episodes.title: Birds of the upper meadow
episodes.summary: Margaret sits still in the upper meadow for an hour and writes down every bird she hears.

episodes.title: The spring under the old oak
episodes.summary: There is a spring under the old oak that never runs dry. Margaret asks around about it.

episodes.title: Why the fog sits in the valley
episodes.summary: The fog in the valley this week, and why it stays put on a still morning.

episodes.title: A week of westerly wind
episodes.summary: The wind has come from the west all week. Linus explains where it started and when it will turn.

episodes.title: The first snow on the ridge
episodes.summary: Snow on the ridge but rain in the town: one storm, two kinds of weather.

episodes.title: Reading the clouds
episodes.summary: Three kinds of cloud you can see from any window, and what each one says about tomorrow.

episodes.title: Why sync-inventory failed on Tuesday
episodes.summary: Sync-inventory failed at the validate step on Tuesday night. Ada walks through the run, linus through the fix.

episodes.title: Faster nightly exports
episodes.summary: The nightly-export job got twice as fast this week. Linus explains what changed in the transform step.

episodes.title: A new scheduler for larkspur
episodes.summary: The larkspur project moved to the new scheduler. What moved, what broke, and what got better.

episodes.title: The send-digest rewrite
episodes.summary: Send-digest gets a new notify step. Ada and linus argue about the wording of the email.

episodes.title: The island with one road
episodes.summary: One road, one shop, one ferry a day, and a hundred and forty people who would not live anywhere else.

episodes.title: An island made by a volcano
episodes.summary: Black sand, warm springs and a mountain that last woke up two hundred years ago.

episodes.title: The island you can walk to
episodes.summary: A tidal island joined to the land twice a day, and the people who plan their lives around it.

episodes.title: The smallest island with a school
episodes.summary: Six pupils, one teacher, and a classroom with a view of the sea.

episodes.title: Where the river starts
episodes.summary: Up in the snowfields, where the river is a trickle you can step across.

episodes.title: The towns on the banks
episodes.summary: Three towns on the same river, each built where the water let them.

episodes.title: The delta and the sea
episodes.summary: Where the river slows down, splits into a hundred channels and finally meets the salt.

episodes.title: The flood of the spring thaw
episodes.summary: Every spring the river rises. Margaret talks to the people who remember the biggest flood.

episodes.title: The keeper who stayed forty years
episodes.summary: One keeper, one lamp and forty years of nights on the point.

episodes.title: The light on the rock
episodes.summary: A lighthouse built on a bare rock out at sea, and how they got the stones there.

episodes.title: When the lights went automatic
episodes.summary: The year the last keepers left, and what the lighthouses do without them.

episodes.title: Fog signals
episodes.summary: Before radios there were horns, bells and guns. Grace tries to find one that still works.

episodes.title: How a beach moves
episodes.summary: A beach is never still. Ada follows one grain of sand along the coast for a year.

episodes.title: The cliffs that fall
episodes.summary: The cliffs lose a little every winter. Ada visits the edge and the people who live near it.

episodes.title: Dunes that hold the sea back
episodes.summary: The dunes behind the beach, the grass that holds them together, and the storm that tested them.

episodes.title: Pebbles
episodes.summary: Why some beaches are sand and some are stones, and what the stones can tell you.

episodes.title: Paged at three in the morning
episodes.summary: Grace was paged at three in the morning when rebuild-index failed. What she did, step by step.

episodes.title: The queue that never empties
episodes.summary: The worker queue grew all night and nobody knew why. Linus finds the import-orders job behind it.

episodes.title: A quiet night
episodes.summary: Nothing failed. Grace and linus talk about what a good night on call looks like.

episodes.title: Retries and backoff
episodes.summary: When a job fails at the upload step, how long should it wait before it tries again?
